newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks rise in early morning on land auction.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks rise in early morning on land auction.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rose in early morning trade on Tuesday, following gains in futures overnight in Chicago. The market was also boosted by Monday's better-than-expected auction of land owned by the now-defunct Japan National Railways, brokers said.
As of 0016 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average climbed 222.69 points or 1.23 percent to 18,308.64. Its March futures were 170 points higher at 18,310.
"The Nikkei closed in a bearish mood yesterday, but the market is expected to try going upwards after the rise in Chicago," said an analyst at a major Japanese securities house.
